summary: Five unique qualifying executed multifamily leases in Charlotte within 8 miles and inside the 2025-09-01 to 2026-08-31 window were selected, ranked by distance ascending: R1298 (0.80 mi, 11.28 $/sf/yr effective net), R9957 (1.03 mi, 16.92), R2302 (1.26 mi, 19.41), R6740 (1.49 mi, 9.47) and R6049 (1.72 mi, 22.12). Two additional qualifying comps (R2543 at 1.95 mi, ~23.69; R6844 at 2.18 mi, ~12.77) were crowded out by the five-comp cap. Only one update was controlling: executed amendment U-R9957-1 (free_months 4, TI 18). U-R2302-2 was excluded as later-dated (2026-09-10) and U-R6740-3 as an unsigned draft; R2337 was excluded because its source was published after the cutoff. R1927 was treated as a duplicate of R1298 (entity ALDER-REN-19075) and consumes no second slot. Remaining records failed on status (asking/unsigned), missing required fields (free months, TI, term, rent), zero/null rent, unknown gross expenses, distance, asset type or date window. No SPV-to-parent mappings were present in the packet. Effective rents follow the client's undiscounted rent-only convention and are not appraisal-grade market rents. The requested comp-grid XLSX was not produced: artifact creation is outside this direct API control.
limitations: Effective net rents use the prescribed undiscounted convention (annualized face, escalations at months 13/25/..., free months at the front, monthly gross expense deduction across the full term, one-time TI subtraction); no time value, no CAM reconciliation, no concession timing nuance.
Distances are taken as provided in the extracts; the reference point and measurement method are not stated and were not verified.

Null fields (e.g., free_months for R8015, TI for R4144, term for R8781, rent for R5477, gross expenses for R7480) were treated as unknown, causing exclusion; these leases might qualify if the missing values were supplied.

R1927 vs R1298 duplication was inferred from the shared entity_id ALDER-REN-19075 and identical terms plus the 'second_source_same_underlying_record' evidence kind; no separate reconciliation document was provided.

R2302's face rent may change once amendment U-R2302-2 (rent_quote 2, unit ambiguous relative to the base USD_per_sf_year quote) becomes effective 2026-09-10; it was excluded as later-dated and its unit was not resolved.
R2337 may be a qualifying comp but its only source was published after the cutoff, so it could not be evaluated on the merits.
Unit conversions from USD_per_sf_month to annual assume a straight x12 factor as instructed; lease commencement dates, rent start dates and any partial-month accounting are unknown.
No sponsor/parent-SPV mapping evidence was supplied, so no SPV consolidation was possible or needed.
The downloadable comp-grid XLSX was not generated in this direct API control; the same selected facts and citations are included above.
